## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [那連提耶舍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%82%A3%E9%80%A3%E6%8F%90%E8%80%B6%E8%88%8D) Narendrayaśas treats the bodhisattva *Liánhuāmiàn* 蓮華面 (Lotus-Face) and his interactions with the Buddha at the time of the *parinirvāṇa*. The text contains substantial *mò fǎ* (decline-of-Dharma) narrative material.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Narendrayaśas's late-life Suí period (582–589 CE).
